issue.title: test_empty_panel_semicolon_hops_to_palette_and_back flakes in parallel check
issue.description: Proposed by phase sase-19f.6.1 note #1 while implementing queue multiplier projection. This ACE command-line navigation test failed in a full parallel just check lane and then passed serially and in a small -n 4 run on the unchanged tree. Investigate the failure under the wide lane, capture the assertion and load conditions, and fix the test or underlying timing behavior. No failure count beyond one fail/one rerun pass was recorded.

task_type_fields.evidence: Phase sase-19f.6.1 note #1: one failure during full parallel load, followed by serial and -n 4 passes on the unchanged tree; observed rate one failure in the recorded run, with no repeated sample.

payload.entry: Supplemental recurrence after creation: required landing check ToolRun d190e80c5ed4c9e63deb9662cd86a27f failed tests/ace/tui/command_line/test_panel_shell.py::test_empty_panel_semicolon_hops_to_palette_and_back in a six-worker broad parallel pytest lane (48000 passed, 14 failed total); triage classified this node KNOWN. This is a second parallel-lane failure after the one reported by proposing phase sase-19f.6.1 note #1. Serial and -n 4 passes from the phase remain the unchanged-tree pass evidence.

evidence.note: sase-1ab land agent: sase-1ab.4 note #4 item 2 saw tests/ace/tui/command_line/test_panel_shell.py semicolon-hop fail under parallel load during turn-rename verification, then pass on a solo rerun (same tree). Third independent parallel-lane observation.

Relayed from epic sase-1d7 landing: phase sase-1d7.12 (note 1 item 5) saw test_empty_panel_semicolon pilot timeout under the parallel just check lane on 2026-09-30 with the phase stashed; it passed in isolation. Not caused by sase-1d7.

Flaked again in sase tool run cdcd017e9d742389d28d342dc6bf0c0d (sase-1dq landing, scoped lane 522 files, 4 workers); passes in isolation on the same tree with and without the landing diff (next-word widgets only, no command-line panel code).
